title: Tianji Record, Page Six
next_chapter_hook: The blood-red warning seared into Page Six of the Tianji Record—those who continue the investigation shall die. Chen Ji had not yet recovered from his father's death when urgent knocking echoed at the door.

text.content:
Midnight.

In a decrepit woodshed on the Rear Mountain of the Tianqing Sect, the candle had long since burned out, leaving only a stub of cold wax pooled in a bronze tray, like a pallid tear. Chen Ji sat alone on a rotting wooden stool, hands clasped atop his knees, knuckles blanched from tension.

Beyond the window, the night wind wailed, much like his father's lullabies from childhood. His chest still retained the nauseating chill left behind by the retreating Demonic Path commander—the Heavenly Eyes were about to awaken.

These words were like a rusted iron nail, driven deep into his crown, each breath driving the pain deeper.

He slowly undid his robe. On his chest, a fragmentary rune glowed with a ghostly blue light in the darkness. The Tianji Record hovered above his dantian, its pages trembling faintly, as if sensing the tumultuous waves within its master's heart.

The information transmitted by the Demonic Path commander tonight was too horrifying. The Heavenly Eyes—that existence which the Chen family ancient texts had left with only two words: 'Speak not'—was actually about to awaken? And he, a mere servant disciple, was the last thread of the bloodline recorded in the ancient texts as the 'Gatekeeper'?

Chen Ji closed his eyes. His father Chen Tianming's honest yet worried face surfaced once more.

Father, what did you know that led to your death…

Just as his thoughts brushed against the cause of his father's death, the Tianji Record shuddered violently!

The fragmentary pages turned of their own accord, Page Six slowly surfacing without anyone's touch. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—he had memorized the first five pages by heart, but this page, he had never seen.

The characters on the page moved like living things, first inscribed in archaic gold seal script, then twisting and reforming, finally settling into a scene that shook the soul:

A massive formation that used all living beings as sacrifice. Countless chains extended from every corner of heaven and earth, binding a... an eye. An eye that encompassed the sun and moon, that contained the starry rivers.

Deep within its pupil lay infinite indifference.

dialogue.content: So this is... the Heavenly Eyes?

text.content:
Below the image, ancient text flowed forth like water, each character seeming to weigh a thousand catties:

'In the primordial age, the Heavenly Eyes descended upon the world, treating all living things as straw dogs, playing with reincarnation at will. Every prophet across generations was its chess piece, none met good ends. Only the Tianji Record, forged by the ancestors at the cost of their lives, serves as the lock binding its pupils and suppressing its will.

The Chen bloodline has been Gatekeepers through the ages, commanding the Tianji Record and guarding the shackles upon all living things. If the shackles break, the Heavenly Eyes awaken, and the world descends into chaos.'

Chen Ji's breath nearly stopped. Gatekeepers… Chen family ancestors… He had been treated as worthless his whole life, his father never revealed their family history, and the mission they bore was actually to protect all of humanity's peace?

The text continued scrolling downward, and a passage rendered in blood-red suddenly appeared:

'The seventh master of the Tianji Record, Chen Tianming, discovered the truth of the loosening shackles in the thirty-second year of Jingyuan. Following the traces, he investigated to the periphery of the Kunlun Forbidden Land, startling the remnant consciousness of the Heavenly Eyes. The Heavenly Eyes' remnant took Chen Nian as hostage, forcing Chen Tianming to submit. Chen Tianming refused to surrender, and in the autumn of the same year was eliminated on the Rear Mountain of the Tianqing Sect.'

Chen Ji froze.

The Rear Mountain. That was where he was found, and where he was 'rescued' by the Tianqing Sect elders. So it was not rescue, but cleanup after the elimination. His father died on that same night he was picked up.

dialogue.content: (Fingernails dug deep into his palms, blood seeping out and dripping to the ground) …So you were eliminated. Not an accident, not enemies seeking revenge… it was because you wanted to protect the shackles, to protect… me.

text.content:
His voice echoed through the woodshed in the deep night, carrying an uncontrollable tremor. No one answered him.

The Tianji Record seemed to sense his grief, and Page Six continued revealing new content. This passage was written with bold, powerful strokes, the brushwork revealing a familiarity that resonated with Chen Ji's bloodline:

'Chen Xuan, the fifteenth master of the Tianji Record, on his deathbed entrusted the Tianji Record fragments to his young son Chen Tianming, with these final words: The secret of the shackles must not be passed on lightly. The remnant consciousness of the Heavenly Eyes still lurks in the shadows, waiting for the Gatekeeper bloodline to be extinguished. Remember—though the fragments are incomplete, the heart of guardianship must not falter. My son, Jier, I hope you never have to know the truth.'

Chen Ji jerked his head up.

Chen Xuan. The fifteenth master. Entrusted to young son Chen Tianming.

That was… his great-grandfather.

dialogue.content: Great-grandfather… you passed the Tianji Record to Father, and Father hid it… in my body? But I didn't even know about this myself!

text.content:
He remembered countless late nights in his childhood when his father would lightly touch his chest with fingertips after he had fallen asleep, murmuring syllables he couldn't understand. Back then, he only felt a slight warmth in his chest, thinking his father was driving away nightmares.

So that was not dispelling demons, but using his life as the price, transferring fragments of the Tianji Record into him piece by piece.

The last words his father spoke when he looked at him before dying now exploded in his ears:

"Jier, survive. Don't investigate."

He didn't want to keep him ignorant—he wanted him to live.

Chen Ji slowly knelt on the icy ground, both fists pressed against his forehead.

He had presented himself as a废物 his whole life, calculating everything, never revealing emotion easily. But at this moment, the grief suppressed for over a decade burst forth like a flood breaching a dam, washing away all his masks.

Father did not die in an accident.

Father was exterminated by the remnant consciousness of the Heavenly Eyes to protect this shackle, to protect his worthless son.

And all these years… he had actually been kept in the dark!

dialogue.content: (Slowly rising, tears still wet on his face, yet his expression had turned cold as iron) Father, you guarded this shackle your entire life, only to meet such an end. This debt, your son will collect it for you.

text.content: He slowly drew the Tianji Record back into his dantian. The rune on his chest grew faintly warm from the surge of emotion. The urge for vengeance burned like fire poured onto dry kindling. But he had not lost his senses—he wanted to crush the culprits with his own hands, not rush to his death.

dialogue.content: (Suddenly looking up) Chen Nian… the Heavenly Eyes took Chen Nian as hostage to force Father to submit… if Chen Nian is still alive, she must know something!

text.content: The secret Father guarded with his life might hold answers on his sister. He couldn't just focus on revenge—he had to find his sister too, for she was another bloodline Father traded his life to protect.

Just then, a blood-red glow suddenly flickered at the bottom of Page Six of the Tianji Record!

The light writhed like a living thing, finally coalescing into a line of chilling words, each character seeming written in fresh blood:

'Warning—those who continue investigating the secret of the shackles shall die.'

The calligraphy was scarlet fresh, as if just branded onto the page. Chen Ji stared fixedly at those words, a bone-deep chill crawling from the soles of his feet to the crown of his skull.

This was a threat. A threat from the Heavenly Eyes.

Chen Ji stared at the blood-red warning, yet the corner of his lips slowly curved into a mocking arc.

Die?

His father was dead, his sister was missing, and he himself had skirted death countless times. The choices the Tianji Record gave him had only ever been one—to defy heaven and change fate.

He extended his right index finger, and beneath the blood-red warning, he wrote two characters, stroke by stroke:

I will investigate.

The calligraphy was bold and forceful, penetrating through the paper.

dialogue.content: (Closing the Tianji Record and storing it in his dantian, his gaze cold and abyssal) Want my life? Come take it then. But before that, I will personally overturn every piece you've placed on the board. Father's death, I've recorded it. Heavenly Eyes… we'll see how this plays out.

text.content:
Outside the window, the night wind suddenly surged, as if responding to his silent declaration of war.

The secret of Page Six of the Tianji Record had been fully revealed—the Chen family were ancient Gatekeepers, the Tianji Record was the key to sealing the Heavenly Eyes, and his father Chen Tianming was eliminated on the Rear Mountain of the Tianqing Sect for discovering the truth.

That eye encompassing sun and moon, that will gazing coldly upon the mortal world—it was the true killer of his father.

Chen Ji slowly rose and pushed open the door of the woodshed. The night was as ink, the stars scattered across the heavens. He gazed toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect Main Peak, his eyes reflecting the cold starlight.

Ling Yuan… the one who 'rescued' him back then—was it really just coincidence that he was present?

The answer was perhaps hidden within the deepest secrets of the Tianqing Sect.
